notes: Company background: omni-channel e-commerce platform (apparel + accessories), strong seasonality (Nov-Dec peak), heavy promotion traffic
Primary problem: current lexical search + boosting rules fail for synonyms, long-tail queries, and promotion re-ranking during spikes
Indexing scale: ~15M SKUs including variants; average 40 attributes per SKU; images + merchant attributes to be embedded; plan for nightly incremental refresh
Latency & throughput targets: 95th pct < 120ms for top-K retrieval (embedding nearest neighbors) under normal load; rerank end-to-end target < 250ms; peak QPS target 3k sustained, 12k burst
Cost sensitivity: target blended cost-per-query (retrieve+ranks) <$0.003 at normal load; <$0.01 acceptable during holiday peaks for conversion uplift
Model preferences: open model allowed (checked 13B/7B family), prefer 8-bit quantized variants for cost; willing to test Redwood-recommended variants
Routing/fallback needs: prefer routing to dedicated POOL in NA, fallback to lower-cost hosted model in burst; must avoid routing to non-EU when query tagged residency=EU
Security: SSO & SAML required for admin console; audit logs for index writes; KMS for key management on Dedicated; DPA required for EU data
Quote from Head of Search: "We need predictable unit economics during Black Friday — can't have surprise token bills."
Internal stakeholders: Head of Product, Search Eng, Infra SRE, Legal/Security. AE has introduced SE and CSM to all parties
POC note: prefer measured experiments — A/B on reranker during 2% of traffic before ramping to full traffic; success metric = CTR lift + conversion delta per dollar spent
poc_scope_summary: Index 15M SKUs, generate 768-dim embeddings for title+attributes+merchant signals, build ANN index, run reranker on top-10 candidates. Measure latency, recall@10, CTR uplift and cost per query.
indexing_constraints: Nightly full refresh takes ~6 hours currently; want incremental near-real-time on price/promotions (<=5min). Concerned about storage cost of dense vectors for 15M+ items.
latency_targets: retrieve 95th<120ms, rerank end-to-end 95th<250ms; p50 targets 30ms/120ms respectively
qps_peaks: normal: 3k qps sustained; peak-burst: 12k qps for 1-3 hour windows during promotions/holiday
